cases.description: 3 7/8 % TIPS, base Ref CPI 164, Ref CPI 166.2 on the first payment date, 100,000 par (quantity 1,000): index ratio 1.01341, the coupon on 100,000
cases.source: 31 CFR 356 Appendix B, I.B example: ratio 166.2 / 164 = 1.01341463 truncated to six decimals 1.013414, rounded to five 1.01341; coupon 100,000 x 0.03875 / 2 x 1.01341 = 1,963.48 (https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356)

cases.description: Daily Ref CPI and index ratios of July 2026 on the three bases, from CPI-U NSA March 330.213, April 333.020 and May 335.123
cases.source: Treasury, Ref CPI and Index Ratios for July 2026 (https://www.treasurydirect.gov/instit/annceresult/tipscpi/2026/CPI_20260610.pdf): 2026-07-02 333.08784; 2026-07-15 333.96974; 2026-07-31 335.05516; Ref CPI of the 1st of a month is the CPI-U of the month three months back, a later day interpolates linearly to the next month's, truncated to six decimals then rounded to five

cases.description: Deflation at maturity: 1,000 par (quantity 10), index ratio 0.98000: the principal is paid at par, the final coupon is on 980.00
cases.source: 31 CFR 356 Appendix B, I.B.3 (the principal paid at maturity is not below the par amount): ratio 160.72 / 164 = 0.98; coupon 1,000 x 0.04 / 2 x 0.98 = 19.60 (the 2 % half-year on 980.00)
